summary: Sole dependency resolved from an off-registry HTTP URL, executed at install time
details: package.json (line 12) declares the package's only dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as the bare URL https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever bytes that host returns, with no version pin and no integrity hash, and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched archive. The shipped code is a one-line stub (index.js: module.exports = require('linker-client-string-async')), so the manifest itself is the entire delivered surface. Package metadata is placeholder content (description "Generated package", author "Package Registry", repository github.com/example/...), and the host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage, so the content delivered at install time can be changed at any time by whoever controls that host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
